outcome: A spell cast with a card spliced onto it gains that card's text and its caster pays the splice cost; the spliced card stays in hand.
Splice is unavailable when the card's targets cannot be chosen, and a card cannot be spliced twice onto one spell.
note: spliced effects happening after the main spell is a mechanical consequence folded into this line

outcome: The spliced spell keeps its own characteristics and gains only the rules text, so protection is checked against the main spell's color.
A spell with targets from spliced text does not resolve if all its targets are illegal on resolution.
The spell loses the spliced text when it leaves the stack.
